sop_modules.name: Setup — Floor, Trim Masking, Fixture Covers, Furniture Protection
sop_modules.description: Full setup module for interior wall repaint. Includes floor protection (method-dependent), trim edge masking (always — trim is in place for RP), fixture covers (spray methods or QT4+ roll), and furniture protection (occupied homes). RP adds furniture protection and always-on trim masking vs NC.

tasks.name: Move and Center-Pile Furniture
tasks.description: Move furniture to center of room, at least 4 ft from all walls. Protect electronics and valuables. Clear wall surfaces of hanging items.

tasks.name: Cover Center-Piled Furniture with Poly Sheeting
tasks.description: Cover center-piled furniture and contents with 2-4 mil poly sheeting. Tape edges to floor to prevent paint dust and overspray from reaching contents.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Perimeter — Roll Method)
tasks.description: Install perimeter floor protection using canvas drop cloths. Position drops under work areas to catch drips from cut-in and roller work. RP always has finished floors.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup (Full Room — Spray Methods)
tasks.description: Install full-room floor protection. Hard floors: rosin paper with taped seams. Carpet: plastic sheeting with taped edges. Required for spray/spray_backroll overspray containment.

tasks.name: Mask Baseboard Top Edge
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along top edge of baseboard to protect finished trim from wall paint. Press edge firmly for clean seal. RP always has trim in place — this task is mandatory.

tasks.name: Mask Door Casing Edges
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along door casing edges adjacent to walls. Protect finished trim from wall paint.

tasks.name: Mask Window Casing Edges
tasks.description: Apply masking tape along window casing edges adjacent to walls. Protect finished trim from wall paint.

tasks.name: Cover Fixtures for Spray / Premium Roll
tasks.description: Apply covers to electrical outlets, switches, and wall-mounted fixtures. Required for spray methods. Recommended for roll at QT4+ to prevent drip risk. ~6 outlets/switches per room average.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Furniture move → Furniture cover → Floor protection → Trim masking (baseboard → door casing → window casing) → Fixture covers. All setup complete before assessment begins.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment
sop_modules.description: RP-specific assessment phase. Visual condition scan, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, moisture evaluation, and coating identification. Results drive downstream task activation (primer selection, prep intensity, contamination treatment). No NC equivalent — 100% RP_NEW tasks.

tasks.name: Visual Condition Scan — All Walls
tasks.description: Walk all wall surfaces with work light. Photograph defects, map damage areas, assign severity per wall. Identify worst-condition wall to determine room-level condition_scale (GOOD/FAIR/POOR). Document scope of scraping, peeling, staining.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick visual scan, note major issues only
quality_notes.QT3: Standard visual with work light, document all visible defects
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph all defect areas
quality_notes.QT5: Critical assessment, multiple passes, raking light, full photographic documentation

tasks.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
tasks.description: Perform cross-hatch tape test per ASTM D3359 at representative areas and any suspect zones. Test at minimum 2 locations per room. Results determine if adhesion primer is required.

tasks.name: Moisture Meter Evaluation
tasks.description: Test wall moisture content at suspect areas using pin-type or pinless moisture meter. Flag active moisture sources for remediation by other trades. Active moisture is a STOP WORK condition — do not proceed until source is resolved.

tasks.name: Coating Identification — Latex vs Oil
tasks.description: Determine existing coating type via solvent test: mineral spirits dissolves alkyd, does not dissolve latex. Critical for primer compatibility — latex over oil requires adhesion primer.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Condition scan first → Adhesion test at suspect areas → Moisture eval at suspect areas → Coating ID. Assessment results determine which prep and prime tasks activate downstream.

sop_modules.name: Lead-Safe RRP Containment (Shared Module)
sop_modules.description: Shared lead-safe work practice module for all 9 interior RP specs. Conditional on home built before 1978. Includes lead test, containment setup, wet methods, HEPA vacuum, containment removal, and waste disposal. This module is NOT owned by this spec — it is a shared module referenced by all interior RP specs.

tasks.name: Lead Test (XRF or Swab)
tasks.description: Perform lead test at representative areas. XRF preferred; lead swab test acceptable. Test at minimum 2 locations per room on different walls.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Setup
tasks.description: Install containment: poly sheeting on floors and openings, warning signs at entry points, restrict entry to certified personnel only. Per EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745.

tasks.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
tasks.description: HEPA vacuum all surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance to capture lead-contaminated dust. Required by EPA RRP Rule.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Removal and Visual Clearance
tasks.description: Remove containment poly sheeting, perform visual clearance inspection. No visible dust or debris. Dispose containment materials per EPA RRP waste handling rules.

tasks.name: Lead-Contaminated Waste Disposal
tasks.description: Package and dispose of lead-contaminated debris, containment materials, and cleaning supplies per EPA RRP Rule. Label and transport to approved disposal facility.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Lead test first → If positive: containment setup → All prep tasks use wet methods → HEPA vacuum after each disturbance → Containment removal after all prep complete → Waste disposal.

sop_modules.name: Prep — Degloss, Scrape, Feather, Contamination Treatment, Fill, Dust Removal
sop_modules.description: Condition-driven prep module. GOOD condition: degloss/scuff + dust wipe. FAIR condition: add scrape, feather, contamination treatment, fill/patch. POOR condition: full scrape, extensive feathering, contamination treatment, full fill. Prep pool modifiers apply: condition_scale x contamination_type x wall_access.

tasks.name: TSP Wash for Surface Contamination
tasks.description: TSP (trisodium phosphate) wash for grease film, kitchen residue, smoke residue, or general surface contamination. Wipe on, scrub, rinse, allow to dry. Required before degloss or coating application when contamination is present.

quality_notes.QT2: Single pass with TSP solution, rinse
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic wash with rinse verification, work light check
quality_notes.QT5: Multiple passes as needed until clean, full verification

tasks.name: Mildew/Biocide Treatment
tasks.description: Apply bleach or mildewcide solution to mildew-affected areas. Allow full contact/kill time per product directions. Rinse and allow to dry completely. Source moisture must already be resolved (gate condition from assessment).

tasks.name: Scrape Loose and Failing Paint
tasks.description: Scrape all failing, peeling, flaking, or loose paint to sound substrate using putty knife or paint scraper. Work systematically section by section. Remove all non-adhering coating.

quality_notes.QT2: Remove obviously loose material, major peeling areas
quality_notes.QT3: Remove all failing paint, thorough scrape of affected areas
quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive scrape with careful edge work, identify all weak adhesion zones
quality_notes.QT5: Critical scrape — near-zero tolerance for remaining loose material

tasks.name: Feather-Sand Scrape Edges
tasks.description: Feather-sand all scrape edges to create smooth transition between bare substrate and remaining sound paint. Critical to prevent ridge telegraphing through finish coats. Non-negotiable at all tiers.

quality_notes.QT3: Smooth transition, no visible ridge at 6 ft
quality_notes.QT4: Near-invisible transition, no ridge at 3 ft
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect transition, no ridge at arm's length

tasks.name: Degloss Existing Paint Surface
tasks.description: Chemical degloss (liquid sander wipe-on) or mechanical scuff (120-150 grit sandpaper) to promote adhesion of new coating. Required on all sound paint surfaces. Chemical degloss is faster but requires dry time.

quality_notes.QT5: Complete degloss with bonding verification and spot adhesion re-test

tasks.name: Fill Wall Defects — Spackle
tasks.description: Apply lightweight spackle to nail holes, dings, scrapes, minor damage, and scrape-transition areas. Feather edges for smooth transition.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill all visible defects, reasonable feathering
quality_notes.QT4: Fill all defects with careful feathering, invisible repairs
quality_notes.QT5: Near-zero defect tolerance, wide feathering, multiple thin coats as needed

tasks.name: Sand Spackled Areas
tasks.description: Sand spackled areas smooth after dry. Use 150-180 grit. Blend repairs into surrounding surface.

quality_notes.QT3: Sand and blend, repair should not telegraph
quality_notes.QT5: Sand to perfection, wet sponge test for smoothness

tasks.name: Assess and Replace Failed Caulk
tasks.description: Inspect all existing caulk joints (wall-to-trim, wall-to-ceiling, corners). Remove and replace cracked, shrunk, or failed sections. RP differs from NC — NC applies new caulk to bare joints; RP assesses existing and replaces only failed sections.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive assessment, replace all suspect joints
quality_notes.QT5: Critical assessment, replace all joints not in perfect condition

tasks.name: Dust Wipe Wall Surfaces
tasks.description: Wipe all wall surfaces with damp cloth or tack cloth to remove sanding dust, degloss residue, and debris before priming or finish coat application.

tasks.name: Vacuum Wall and Floor Dust After Prep
tasks.description: HEPA vacuum wall surfaces and floor area to remove all prep dust (sanding, scraping, spackling) before coating application.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: TSP wash (if contaminated) → Mildew treatment (if moisture damage) → Scrape loose paint (if FAIR/POOR) → Feather edges (if scraped) → Degloss (if sound/failing paint) → Spackle defects (QT3+) → Sand spackle (QT3+) → Caulk assess/replace (QT3+) → Dust wipe → Vacuum. All prep must be complete and dry before prime.

sop_modules.name: Prime — State-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: State-driven primer module. Primer product selection determined by substrate state: SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT may skip prime or use adhesion primer; SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING use adhesion primer (spot or full); SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE uses mildew-resistant primer; SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE uses shellac stain-blocker (full surface). Application method matches finish method (roll/spray_backroll/spray).

tasks.name: Cut-In Primer at Ceiling Line
tasks.description: Brush-cut primer along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Freehand cut-in — do NOT mask drywall ceilings. Clean line extending 2-3 inches down wall for roller overlap.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks

tasks.name: Roll Primer on Wall
tasks.description: Apply state-driven primer to wall field using 9-inch roller. Primer product varies by substrate state: adhesion primer for failing/peeling, mildew-resistant for moisture damage, shellac stain-blocker for smoke damage. W pattern, maintain wet edge.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — no drips, sags, holidays, or lap marks. Surface must be uniformly sealed.

tasks.name: Spray Primer on Wall
tasks.description: Apply state-driven primer via airless sprayer. Proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Spray directly into wall-to-ceiling corner (no cut-in needed for spray). Primer product varies by substrate state.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — uniform coverage, proper mil thickness.

tasks.name: Backroll Sprayed Primer
tasks.description: Immediately follow spray with roller to consolidate primer. Use 18-inch roller on extension pole. Backroll is MANDATORY for primer on previously painted surfaces to ensure adhesion and eliminate air pockets.

quality_notes.all: Primer fully consolidated. No air pockets. Backroller follows sprayer closely.

tasks.name: Spot Prime Scraped/Repaired Areas
tasks.description: Apply spot primer to all scraped areas, feathered edges, spackled repairs, and exposed substrate. Prevents flashing from differential absorption. For GOOD condition when only localized areas need attention.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot prime all spackled and scraped areas
quality_notes.QT4: Spot prime all repairs with feathered edges
quality_notes.QT5: Spot prime all repairs with wide feather, may need light sand after

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in primer at ceiling (roll method only) → Roll/spray primer → Backroll (spray_backroll method). Spot prime is independent — used for localized repairs regardless of full-prime status. Skip entire module for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT when adhesion test passes.

sop_modules.name: Interstage — Between Coats
sop_modules.description: Interstage maintenance between coats. QT4/QT5: light sand, vacuum dust, inspect, patch defects, spot coat. QT3: spot sand patches only if necessary. Run rule: AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat.
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat. For prime+2finish: runs after prime, after finish coat 1. For 2finish (no prime): runs after finish coat 1.

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Light sand previous coat with 220 grit pole sander to smooth nibs, imperfections, and raised grain before next coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Light even pass to smooth nibs

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats (Critical)
tasks.description: Careful sanding between coats with inspection under work light. Critical for satin/semi-gloss finishes where every imperfection shows.

quality_notes.QT5: Careful sanding with raking light inspection. Critical for satin/semi-gloss.

tasks.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from walls before applying next coat. HEPA vacuum with brush attachment or tack cloth follow-up.

tasks.name: Inspect Between Coats
tasks.description: Visual inspection of previous coat before applying next. Identify holidays, drips, lap marks, or imperfections requiring touch-up.

quality_notes.QT3: Standard visual inspection, note obvious defects
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection with raking light, multiple passes

tasks.name: Patch Interstage Defects
tasks.description: Spackle and sand any defects found during intercoat inspection: drips, sags, missed spots, raised nap.

quality_notes.QT5: Repair all defects with wide feathering, near-zero tolerance

tasks.name: Spot Coat Patched Areas
tasks.description: Apply spot coat of finish paint to patched areas to equalize absorption before full next coat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Patch defects → Spot coat patches → Light sand (QT4/QT5) → Vacuum dust → Next coat. QT2 has no interstage (single coat). QT3 has inspect + patch only (no full sanding).

sop_modules.name: Finish — Cut-In + Field Application (Roll / Spray_Backroll / Spray)
sop_modules.description: Finish coat application module. DIRECT transfer from NC wall finish — once surface is properly prepped and primed, finish application is identical. Includes cut-in at ceiling line, cut-in at trim tape lines, and field application via roll/spray_backroll/spray. QT2=1 coat, QT3+=2 coats.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line (Finish Coat 1)
tasks.description: Freehand brush-cut finish paint along wall-to-ceiling boundary. Wall painter establishes the clean ceiling line. Do NOT mask drywall ceilings.

quality_notes.QT2: Acceptable if neat, minor wobble tolerated
quality_notes.QT3: Reasonably straight line at 6 ft viewing distance
quality_notes.QT4: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 ft
quality_notes.QT5: Crisp line, no visible wobble at arm's length

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line (Finish Coat 2)
tasks.description: Cut-in ceiling line for second finish coat. Same technique as first coat.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Tape Lines (Coat 1)
tasks.description: Cut in wall paint at baseboard, door casing, and window casing tape lines. Cut into tape edge for clean reveal when tape is removed.

tasks.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Tape Lines (Coat 2)
tasks.description: Cut-in trim edges for second finish coat.

tasks.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply wall finish paint using 9-inch or 18-inch roller with extension pole. W pattern, maintain wet edge. Roll into cut-in areas at ceiling and trim edges.

quality_notes.QT2: Full coverage, minor lap marks acceptable
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks
quality_notes.QT5: Critical application — uniform coverage, perfect technique

tasks.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second wall finish coat. Same technique as first coat.

tasks.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply wall finish paint via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed.

quality_notes.all: No application defects — uniform coverage, proper mil thickness.

tasks.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Immediately follow spray with 18-inch roller to consolidate paint, eliminate air pockets, and level finish. Backroller sets pace for sprayer.

quality_notes.all: Complete backroll, even finish. Backroller follows sprayer closely.

tasks.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second wall finish coat via airless sprayer.

tasks.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Backroll second finish coat immediately after spray.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in ceiling → Cut-in trim → Roll/Spray field → Backroll (spray_backroll). QT2 is single coat. QT3+ is two coats with interstage between.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup — Protection Teardown, Furniture Replace, Customer Walkthrough
sop_modules.description: Full cleanup module for interior wall repaint. Remove trim masking, fixture covers, floor protection. Replace furniture (occupied homes). Vacuum floors. Clean tools. Customer walkthrough (RP-specific). Final inspection.

tasks.name: Remove Trim Masking Tape
tasks.description: Remove masking tape from baseboard, door casing, and window casing edges. Pull at angle for clean release. This spec installed the tape, this spec removes it.

tasks.name: Remove Fixture Covers
tasks.description: Remove tape, paper, and plastic from outlets, switches, and wall-mounted fixtures.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove floor protection (drop cloths or rosin paper/plastic). Fold toward center to contain debris.

tasks.name: Replace Furniture to Original Positions
tasks.description: Remove poly covers, return furniture to original positions, verify no paint damage to contents. Check for paint spatter on furniture, electronics, and flooring under furniture area.

tasks.name: Vacuum Floors
tasks.description: Vacuum floor area to remove paint drips, overspray debris, sanding dust, and general work debris.

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water (latex) or denatured alcohol (shellac stain-blocker cleanup). Store or dispose properly.

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection
tasks.description: Walk and inspect all painted wall surfaces. Check for holidays, lap marks, coverage issues, edge quality. Touch up as needed.

quality_notes.QT2: Quick visual for major misses, ambient light
quality_notes.QT3: Thorough visual with work light, address visible defects

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all painted wall surfaces with work light. Systematic scan at 3 ft distance. Perfect finish expected.

tasks.name: Final Wall Inspection (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical inspection under raking light for satin/semi-gloss finish. Arm's length distance. Any imperfection must be addressed.

tasks.name: Touch-Up Defects Found During Inspection
tasks.description: Brush or mini-roll touch-up on defects identified during final inspection. Holidays, thin spots, edge issues, drips.

quality_notes.QT4: Meticulous touch-up, blend into surrounding finish
quality_notes.QT5: Critical touch-up, perfect blend, no visible repair

tasks.name: Customer Walkthrough
tasks.description: Post-completion room-by-room review with homeowner. Walk each painted room together, identify any touch-up needs, confirm satisfaction, note punch list items. RP-specific — does not exist in NC.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove trim masking → Remove fixture covers → Floor protection teardown → Vacuum floors → Final inspection → Touch-up → Replace furniture → Clean tools → Customer walkthrough. Customer walkthrough is the final task before departure.

round_configurations.name: Full Repaint — Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard full repaint for FAIR/POOR condition. Assessment drives primer selection. Full prep, state-driven primer, 2 finish coats with interstage.
round_configurations.notes: Full execution path. RRP module conditional on home_pre_1978. Interstage runs after primer (before finish 1) and after finish 1 (before finish 2).

round_configurations.name: Economy Repaint — Prime + 1 Finish Coat
round_configurations.description: QT2 economy repaint for FAIR/POOR condition. Assessment, full prep, state-driven primer, single finish coat.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 single coat economy. No interstage sanding. Roll-only application.

round_configurations.name: Cosmetic Refresh — No Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: GOOD condition repaint where adhesion test passes and surface is sound. Skip primer, apply 2 finish coats. Standard for QT3-QT5 on sound paint.
round_configurations.notes: Most common scenario for residential repaint. Sound paint, degloss + 2 finish coats. No primer needed when adhesion test passes. RRP module excluded — GOOD condition unlikely to have lead disturbance (no scraping).

round_configurations.name: Economy Refresh — No Prime + 1 Finish Coat
round_configurations.description: QT2 economy refresh for GOOD condition. Minimal prep, no primer, single finish coat. Landlord refresh, rental turnover.
round_configurations.notes: Fastest execution path. QT2, GOOD condition, single coat. Most common rental turnover scenario.

applicability_rules.description: QT2 is single finish coat. No interstage sanding, no intercoat inspection module. Roll-only application.
QT3 defaults to two finish coats. One coat acceptable if full coverage achieved. Interstage: inspect and patch only (no full sanding).
applicability_rules.coat_count_notes: Default 2 coats. 1 coat acceptable if full coverage achieved.

applicability_rules.description: QT4/QT5 requires two finish coats with full interstage sanding between coats.
Spray and spray_backroll methods require fixture covers.
GOOD condition (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT) may skip MOD_WLRP_PRIME entirely when adhesion test passes. Assessment still required.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT activates only when home is pre-1978.
Furniture protection tasks activate only when home is occupied.
TSP wash activates for any contamination type. Mildew treatment activates only for SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE.

assumptions.source: RP market analysis — vast majority of interior repaints are in occupied homes
assumptions.note: Furniture protection tasks are conditional on occupancy_state.

assumptions.value: All trim is installed and finished when RP occurs
assumptions.source: RP context — repainting implies all finish surfaces exist
assumptions.note: Trim masking is always-on in RP. NC prime could skip because trim was not installed.

assumptions.value: Finished flooring is always present in RP context
assumptions.source: RP context — occupied home always has finished floors
assumptions.note: Floor protection is mandatory. NC exception for subfloor does not apply.

assumptions.value: Worst wall condition in the room determines the room's condition_scale
assumptions.source: Practical estimation — per-wall modifiers not supported in estimation engine
assumptions.note: Multiple walls may have different states. Worst state drives room modifier.

assumptions.value: Trim-first is the default RP sequencing (~80% of interior repaints)
assumptions.note: Trim is painted first, then masked off, then walls painted. Wall painter cuts to tape line at trim.

assumptions.value: Do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls — cut-in or spray into corner
assumptions.note: Ceiling line protection is 'none'. Wall painter establishes ceiling line via cut-in.

exclusions.item: Structural drywall repair (holes, water damage to substrate)
exclusions.reason: Out of paint scope — requires drywall repair trade
Texture is pre-paint trade — not part of painting spec
Moisture source resolution is plumbing/building envelope trade — paint spec gates on source being resolved

uncertainties.description: Scrape and feather rates for interior walls are highly variable. No NC baseline. Estimated from exterior RP analogs.
uncertainties.current_approach: Using wide rate ranges (50-100 SF/hr scrape, 40-80 SF/hr feather) for estimation engineer

uncertainties.topic: TSP wash and mildew treatment rates
uncertainties.description: Not well-documented in doctrine. Estimated from professional practice.
uncertainties.current_approach: TSP wash ~200-300 SF/hr, mildew treatment ~100-200 SF/hr (biocide + dwell time)

uncertainties.topic: Wall access modifier not yet in Modifier_Registry
uncertainties.description: wall_access modifier (open_wall/obstructed_light/obstructed_heavy) proposed but not yet formalized.
uncertainties.current_approach: Using proposed values 1.0/1.15/1.30 based on room complexity pattern

critical_constraints.no_ceiling_masking: Do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. Cut in at the ceiling line or spray directly into corner. Only millwork ceilings would require masking.
critical_constraints.shellac_full_surface: SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE requires shellac stain-blocker (BIN) applied to FULL surface. Spot treatment is insufficient — smoke contamination is pervasive. Latex/acrylic primers have ZERO stain blocking capability (RC-002).
critical_constraints.moisture_gate: SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE is a gate condition — moisture SOURCE must be resolved before painting. Painting over active moisture fails within weeks.
critical_constraints.modifier_partition: Prep pool modifiers (condition, contamination, access) NEVER include quality_tier. Coating pool modifiers (QT, access) NEVER include condition or contamination. Pools do not cross-apply.
critical_constraints.backroll_mandatory_spray_prime: Backroll is MANDATORY for spray primer on previously painted surfaces. Spray-only primer is not valid for wall repaint.
